newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends stable in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends stable in modest trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended stable against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday in modest trade that saw light demand for both currencies, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.547 against Tuesday's T$27.543 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$199.5 million, almost unchanged from Tuessday's US$199.
"Trading was basically dull as demand and supply were even, due mainly to absence of market-moving factors," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
He expected the rate to maintain a steady level in the near term.
A T$27.53-56 range was seen for Thursday.
